L3 INDEPENDENT ADR-0020 RE-AUDIT — adjudication support and semantic modelling

TARGET / AUTHORITY
Audited HEAD b57e0fdf5a42432fee4b4bc5f6f6f46b30592e25 on branch eshyra-o9bd.16.3, the dispatched candidate (pack lineage fcc76eae). Git status was empty before and after the audit. This report concerns that exact head; it does not certify a later repair or re-freeze.
Read the lane and parent beads, AGENTS.md, accepted ADR 0020, integrated transition design section 5.9 (all nine conditions), rules-pack compiler guide, importer protocol, review policy including From observation to finding, candidate record and its disclosed limits, and finding-registry contract/rows (with relevant narrowed dispositions).
The operative bar is truthful bounded claims, not universal mechanics/discovery closure. No finding below demands that an unselected mechanic receive an engine implementation. Correctly disclosed engine-pending work and intentional DM interpretation are allowed. No repository edits, formatting, bundle run, commit, push, GitHub action, or changes to another bead were performed. Probes used in-memory databases and files under /tmp only.

CENSUS / OBSERVATIONS
The candidate has 1,799 records, including 240 magic items. Enumerating all magic-item executionReadiness arrays yielded 1,369 clauses: green 333; engine-pending 677; adjudicated-by-design 358; design-blocked 1. Green representation blocks: effects 94, structuredField 94, economies 78, operations 53, entityGrant 8, stateMachine 6. These are classification counts, not execution evidence.
All 358 adjudicated clauses (169 items) have non-empty sourceText that is an exact substring of their own retained description. I inspected the 32 shortest spans and selected longer source/ownership splits. The complete item description remains available beside the short spans; being short was not itself promoted into a defect. The Orb's one design-blocked artifact-property-tables clause explicitly identifies the absent SRD tables and GM-supplied-content limit.
Mapped all 94 green effect clauses to their actual effect kinds; 92 have no declared engineHooks and two have hooks. This identifies a review population, not 92 proven defects. Concrete counterexamples are below.
Record-card probe over all 1,799 records found no identity/source/locator copying mismatch. All 191 emitted feature/subclass parent cards resolved and agreed with the generating record's source/parentClass and level fields. This is structural agreement, not independent source validation of 191 grants.
The candidate record, named bounded audit modules, rule/action disposition report, inventory census, and candidate-gate producers expressly disclaim global completeness. I did not treat their non-claims as proof that their individual statuses or statements are correct.

FINDINGS
L3-F1 — BLOCKER — hook-free passive projections acquire green execution readiness without an execution owner or an explicit DM disposition.
Bar violated: #4 truthful scope/status of readiness artifacts; ADR 0020 sections 2–3 and the lane's clause-level execution-readiness check. This is a false local readiness classification, NOT a demand to implement all passive items or to clear the unselected backlog.
Concrete evidence:
* magic-item:ring-of-regeneration / m2-ring-of-regeneration-regeneration is the item's sole readiness clause, marked green, binding {block: effects, effectId: m2-ring-of-regeneration-regeneration}. Its effect declares regeneration, hitDice 1d6, timing every-10-minutes, condition at least 1 HP. SRD 5.1 p.237: "While wearing this ring, you regain 1d6 hit points every 10 minutes, provided that you have at least 1 hit point."
* /tmp/l3-runtime-probe.ts (successful output /tmp/l3-runtime-probe.out) uses the unmodified bundled pack and registered tools. Give canonical ring -> use returned singleton id -> attune_item -> don_item, with pc-1 at 10/100 HP -> advance_time {minutes:10}. All calls succeed; elapsed time goes 0 -> 10, HP stays 10/100, no regeneration roll or healing is reported. The item has no operation that owns the declared passive healing.
* Independent sibling/state dimension: magic-item:periapt-of-wound-closure / m2-periapt-of-wound-closure-stabilize is green. SRD p.232: "While you wear this pendant, you stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn." Same probe gives, attunes and dons the canonical periapt, opens combat, uses adjust_hp to make the PC dying at 0, then begin_turn for pc-1. It returns turnAvailable:true and boundaryEffects:[]; life_state stays dying. Thus the absent ownership is not confined to clock-based healing. The periapt's separate healingMultiplier clause is also green; that clause was not dynamically tested.
Mechanism: magicItemPassiveEffects.ts:196–202 emits a representation binding with no execution hooks; magicItemCompiler.ts:1120–1125 marks missingHooks.length === 0 green. For these procedures that proves only that no hook was declared, not that code executes the typed trigger or that a reviewed DM remainder has been explicitly classified. The generated green label supplies no narrower representation-only qualification. By comparison, the candidate explicitly leaves other unexecuted effect clauses engine-pending or adjudicated-by-design. The backlog inventory's global non-claims do not make these individual green statuses execution evidence.
RECURRENCE: readiness-integrity, alias opus:F-21 (narrowed surviving obligation: readiness claims no more than it measures). Related source-effect row opus:residual-unverified-effects-semantics is NOT being reopened for missing universal execution.
Suggested owner/fix: magic-item compiler/readiness owner, coordinated by audit-repair owner eshyra-o9bd.16.6. Reconcile the no-hook effect class against actual bounded ownership. These two procedures may truthfully become DM-adjudicated with source spans and existing roll/heal/stabilize primitives, or remain explicitly unselected/engine-pending; actual implementation is another permitted disposition. Do not turn every structural/reference clause red or require global execution closure.
Permanent evidence: retain source-backed exact assertions for these two printed trigger shapes, with a generalized classifier regression preventing omitted execution ownership from being mistaken for executed readiness. Two in-memory boundary probes are proportionate; a full per-item engine suite is not requested. Closure must address the shared no-hook assumption, not just rename these examples.
L3-F2 — BLOCKER — the model-facing packet calls intentional DM adjudication engine-pending.
Bar violated: #4 truthful readiness statements and #9 truthful adjudication-limit disclosure; ADR 0020 section 2 distinguishes intentional model adjudication from unfinished deterministic execution.
Concrete evidence: packages/core/src/discovery/packet.ts:457–467 selects every clause whose readiness is not green, then always says "The record has engine-pending readiness clauses; typed projections are not a capability." packages/core/src/discovery/packetMessage.ts:163–166 renders that statement verbatim beside the projection.
/tmp/l3-packet-probe.ts invokes the real buildContextPacket + retainCandidates + canonical provenance source, then the real renderer, over the unmodified candidate. Bag of Devouring and Efficient Quiver each have ONE readiness clause, adjudicated-by-design, and ZERO engine-pending clauses. Both nevertheless receive that engine-pending assertion. Horn of Valhalla, whose three green plus three adjudicated clauses also contain zero engine-pending clauses, is a third reproduced sibling. The rendered false statements appear at lines 44, 96 and 260 of /tmp/l3-packet-probe.out. The attached evidence itself says adjudicated-by-design, contradicting its model-facing summary.
Sibling search: census query over all 240 magic items finds 21 records with at least one adjudicated clause and zero engine-pending clauses; all meet this same filter. Three packets were dynamically reproduced, not all 21. This includes actual ready grants (Horn), reference/containment (Quiver/Bag), and other mixed green/adjudicated records. The same filter also conflates design-blocked with engine-pending when both are present.
RECURRENCE: readiness-integrity / opus:F-21, the generalized class of readiness summaries claiming more/different than their measured statuses. There is no exact packet-specific registry alias.
Suggested owner/fix: discovery packet/presentation owner (packet.ts and packetMessage.ts), coordinated under eshyra-o9bd.16.6. Derive and report actual readiness categories; say engine-pending only when such clauses exist, and preserve intentional DM, design-blocked and unrecognized distinctions. No new typed magic-item projection is needed to repair this.
Permanent evidence: one generalized category-to-message invariant using a pure adjudicated item, an actual engine-pending item and a mixed-status input. Existing projectionLimitProvenance.test.ts covers source authority but only exercises the engine-pending Ammunition example; it does not distinguish these category errors. This bounded, cheap check is proportionate to authoritative model-facing claims.
L3-F3 — BLOCKER — spend_usage's tool description contradicts its live input contract for class resources.
Bar violated: #6 truthful required inputs of a capability in force, plus #9 truthful adjudication boundary. ADR 0020 sections 2–3 reserve resource accounting to deterministic systems. The defect is the model-facing description; the resource engine correctly fails closed.
Evidence: packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolSpendUsage.ts:31–35 says character abilities have "no structured economy yet" and instructs maxUses + reset on the FIRST spend. But packages/core/src/state/usageCounters.ts:928–980 derives sheet-bound Rage, Ki and Sorcery Points from the active class table and explicitly refuses a declared economy, saying to omit maxUses/reset. The same tool description is injected into the system prompt through protocol.ts:139–146; protocol.ts:304 separately gives the correct exception, so the model receives conflicting instructions.
/tmp/l3-usage-probe.ts creates three fresh in-memory campaigns with canonical level-3 barbarian/monk/sorcerer sheets and invokes the real registry on the unmodified pack. For each of Rage, Ki and Sorcery Points, the description-prescribed first call {ability,maxUses:3,reset:<printed reset>} returns usage_error: "<resource> capacity derives from the class table, not a declared economy; omit maxUses/reset". Immediately calling {ability} succeeds with usesMax:3, usesUsed:1, source:record, and the class reset. This is a normal reachable player ability, not malformed hypothetical state. Output: /tmp/l3-usage-probe.out. The supplied numbers agree with the source/class table; even correct declarations are refused.
Sibling/state analysis: reproduced all three currently bound resource families on first spend, not just Rage. Checked adjacent spend_spell_slot/flexible_casting descriptions and protocol's resource paragraph; those acknowledge code-owned capacities. UsageCounters' older header comments share the stale generic wording, but do not change execution. No improper mutation was observed or alleged. A sheetless or unbound ability still legitimately needs the declared-economy path.
Registry alias: NEW tool-description/input-contract drift; no exact registry alias. sol:CAP-007 (engine-capability-ownership) is related context, not asserted as an exact recurrence.
Suggested owner/fix: orchestrator/tool-description and class-resource owners, under audit-repair coordination. Describe the bound-resource exception and retain the first-spend declaration instruction only for genuinely unbound character abilities/legacy items. Reconcile all model-facing copies so successful use does not depend on recovering from contradictory instructions.
Permanent evidence: a compact semantic assertion that the published description identifies the bound/unbound distinction, alongside the existing generalized class-resource capacity evidence. The three-family runtime probe is an exact reproducer of presentation drift, not a request for another large resource-state suite. No engine rewrite or relaxation of the rejection is warranted.

2. npx vitest run packages/core/test/discovery/projectionLimitProvenance.test.ts packages/core/test/classResourceActiveCapacity.test.ts packages/core/test/dnd5eSrdAuditBundle.test.ts packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemGrantOwnership.test.ts — 4 files, 125 tests passed.

Probes: /tmp/l3-runtime-probe.ts, /tmp/l3-packet-probe.ts, /tmp/l3-usage-probe.ts, /tmp/l3-card-probe.ts, each with a corresponding .out file. Each ran against source modules and the unmodified canonical pack. No readiness waiver or synthetic replacement pack was used. Test-sheet fixtures were used only for the normal class-resource callers. Probes and this report are transient /tmp review aids; durable findings and reproducer recipes are in this bead.

Explicit sampling denominators:
* Enumerated readiness metadata for 240/240 magic items and all 1,369 clauses. Enumeration and resolution/mapping are not semantic or runtime proof for every clause.
* Enumerated 333 green clauses and mapped 94/94 green effects to effect kinds and hook presence. Dynamically challenged the passive clock and start-of-turn boundaries for 2 items (Ring of Regeneration and Periapt), not every green effect, economy, operation, state machine or entity grant. Existing targeted tests exercise further operation/grant families, but I do not claim an independent all-333 runtime proof.
* Checked all 358 adjudicated spans against the retained descriptions; manually inspected the 32 shortest spans plus selected longer responsibility splits. This does not prove that every source clause received a span, that each span independently carries every prerequisite, or that the DM will interpret it correctly. Full descriptions remain relevant context.
* Paired typed projections with retained item prose for 24 named item records: Amulet of Health; Ring of Regeneration; Robe of the Archmagi; Boots of Speed; Gem of Seeing; Ring of Shooting Stars; Ring of Elemental Command; Cubic Gate; Boots of Striding and Springing; Boots of the Winterlands; Broom of Flying; Carpet of Flying; Cloak of Arachnida; Cloak of the Bat; Cloak of the Manta Ray; Goggles of Night; Horseshoes of a Zephyr; Horseshoes of Speed; Periapt of Wound Closure; Ring of Feather Falling; Robe of Eyes; Slippers of Spider Climbing; Winged Boots; Wings of Flying. Direct independent PDF inspection here was limited to SRD pp.232 and 237. Comparisons to other retained descriptions are not independent PDF source-fidelity certification; L1 owns that broader dimension.
* Enumerated the 77 registered default tools. Inspected model-facing descriptions/schema and relevant ownership code for the arithmetic/roll, usage/slot/rest, item/equipment, effect/concentration, condition/HP/death, encounter/turn and lookup/card boundaries, alongside the DM system prompt. Did not execute every tool, every schema branch, provider adapter or capability-inventory branch. Reproduced the description mismatch for 3/3 bound class-resource families, at level 3 and canonical names, not all levels or aliases.
* Mechanically checked all 1,799 record cards and 191 parent cards for agreement with records; did not independently re-read every parent grant against the PDF.
* Query-defined false pending-note population: 21/240 items have adjudicated clauses and no engine-pending clauses. Reproduced packet construction/rendering for Bag of Devouring, Efficient Quiver and Horn of Valhalla, with Ring of Regeneration as a green-only control; did not run a live model or every packet route/budget/variant combination.
* Read the named in-band audit/readiness scope declarations and candidate/gate producers. Did not generate an audit bundle, run reproducibility verification, inspect every historical audit narrative, or claim to have enumerated every prose sentence in the repository. Historical documents carrying an explicit withdrawn-authority banner were not treated as current requirements.
* Did not audit L2's full discovery/relationship universe, L4's complete selected-capability ledger/inventory, or L5's mutation-gate ownership, migration and rollback state space. I inspected those boundaries only where needed to substantiate L3 findings.

Disposition of allowed limits: missing typed projections with faithful retained text and an honest DM disposition were not reported as defects. The candidate explicitly discloses engine-pending/adjudicated work, operation.excludes enforcement, Pipes of the Sewers reachability/evidence, the undecided roll-evidence trust boundary, condition-name discovery leaves, later live-play evaluation and pending formal re-freeze. I do not convert those disclosed bounds into a global engine-completeness requirement. No separate NON-BLOCKER findings were established in this lane.

Report disposition: three concrete blockers requiring ownership/disposition before re-freeze. This is an audit handoff, not a repair, merge authorization or claim of completeness. Only eshyra-o9bd.16.3 is being closed; the parent and other lanes are untouched.
